LanguageData.NR_Courier: A fixer's courier, {0}, is passing through with hot data and will stay for a day. Mercenaries are already on the way for it. Keep {0} on their feet: a safe courier pays {1} silver and the fixer's goodwill.
LanguageData.NR_CourierDone: {0} left with the data. {1} silver is on its way; {2} is grateful (+{3} reputation).
LanguageData.NR_CourierLost: {0} did not make it. The data is gone, and the trail leads to your colony.
LanguageData.NR_CorpHuntIntro: A corporate team has come for your AI server. Defend it: they will try to carry it off or wreck it.
LanguageData.NR_BlackMarket: For {0} days the black market is open to those fixers trust: black braindance, AI fragments, sometimes more. Open: {1}.
LanguageData.NR_Distress: An abandoned server on your land is sending a weak distress signal. A colonist can connect to it (right-click): maybe there is an AI inside, maybe ICE.
LanguageData.NR_DistressFragment: {0} pulled an AI fragment out of the old server.
LanguageData.NR_DistressBacklash: The old server hit {0} with ICE backlash.
LanguageData.NR_MapHack: Hackers have taken over {0} turrets and switched them off. A counter-hack node is in the Gateway for {1} hours: dive and exit cleanly to take them back.
LanguageData.NR_CounterHackWon: The counter-hack worked: your turrets are online again.
